tools.name: search_seeds
tools.description: Search for Balatro seeds matching a JAML filter. Runs a random search of up to 1,000,000 seeds. Returns matching seed strings and relevance scores. In MCP Apps hosts, opens an interactive json-render UI.

tools.name: analyze_seed
tools.description: Analyze a specific Balatro seed against a JAML filter. Returns the seed context for the deck and stake defined in the JAML.

jaml.description: JAML filter JSON — deck and stake are read from this

tools.name: validate_jaml
tools.description: Validate a JAML filter string. Returns valid if the JSON is well-formed JAML, or a descriptive error. Does NOT run a search.

jaml.description: JAML filter JSON string to validate

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: Get the MotelyJAML engine version string.
